details:
Sometime event or game/hangout instances can lasts very long(lasts until hardlimit of 7 days), doesn't necessarily meaning it's a bad thing, but long live instance can have many issues, like recent game worlds do tends to sync tons of the data on entry, which is good thing for game world due to more dynamic contents. But it also make older instance less attractive to the people want fresh rounds, some people wants to find more active instance, or sometime people will went AFK/fall a sleep and make the inactive instance lasts for longer than it should, some people hold the instance for certain game world contents that's only exists by time, and some game(or any worlds) do require fresh start for the most contents to enjoy, all of these requires the awareness to the time and other infos, some people do put the create time on the title, but TBH the time often being cut-out and hard to understand(or things like this non-Latin bug: https://feedback.vrchat.com/bug-reports/p/event-calendar-display-issue-when-the-event-name-is-in-japanesenon-latin ). What I suggest:

1. Add instance create time and uptime on the UI and right side of the menu

2. Filter to allow sorting by time, group, filter out groups, or so

3. Make the instance ID constant. Instance do have it's own ID(the #xxxxx), it's something people can remember, so I think it should always be showned, plus some groups, streamers(or so) do telling people to find certain instance ID, which is useful for people not using the friend system as group usage. Players should also allowed to join via ID(if the owner allowing it for the instance), no matters if it's passed the Recommended Capacity, yes it can be guessed if they try that many of time, but I think this is system part to prevent the force-brute the number.

4. One button to join last instance. Sometime people will crash or went away for other things, and lost progress because they can't found the instance, or they were in the street live world and want to meet certain artists before. This should also ignore the Recommended Capacity since they was in the instance and likely had progress in the instance.

5. Showing 'Had joined on y/m/d h:m' and 'How long' on instance UI.

6. Allow world version codes so people can know what version it is(or was).

7. Add 'Changelogs/announcement/event/Photos/Links' on the tab(besides the Detail/Store/Author), the owner should be allowed to link from group or create it on the world UI, this will make world. Should also allow any groups to submit the events to the world(if owner allow). Photos, people likes to take photos so I guess it's something, can be abused, but it's really nice thing to have.

8. Allow Group to relate to the world. Just like the changelog, many game or other worlds do have it's own official groups, or fan groups. Having groups meaning it will be easier to find other players to play.  TBH, to avoid abuse it should have some sort of the system to prevent easy public listing(like group trust system?), but world owner should be able to decide who can relate(public, submit, or disallowed, block)

9. Allow multiple authors or Group ownership. The current system think uploader is the author, which can't always be true, sometime 'Group' owns it, they should gets the right for their own world(even that meaning it can be abused, hijacked or other bad things, which they shouldn't), the uploader should listed as uploader, but ownership should change. It should also list who owns the admin rights so it harder to be mistaken or imposed. This should also allow roles, like major/sub artist, programmer(codes), basically world credits, to respect or it will be easier to contact authors you like(should also allow to be 'blank' in case the role wants to have privacy. And it should be fillable on picture or name, since many recent worlds do credit GPT or something. To prevent abuse, guess this should somewhat proofable, like being in the Trust rank or the one added the credit need to be age-verified)  (It should also viewable somehow when people are in the instance btw)

10. Showing not just the creator, but also the instance owner(and 'Owner since'). Some people will not like it(should have privacy option to hide tbh), but knowing the ownership is also a important stuff since there are too many confuses to such things.

11. Showing non-AFK players. This part is a bit tricky since the AFK is manually toggled, but I guess such info is still somewhat useful.

12. Times of joins. Some people do like these numbers, it can follows the persistence save I guess, maybe useful if people want to do RTA challenges

Guess this is all, many modern games do have these basic things, and there's a game world bloom on recent weeks, I feel these are more important than before
title: [1953] Modernize world/instance info(expose instance up/create time, ID/owned group or multiple authors, world version/cahangelogs, join last instance, better sort or so)
